laws.text: Order of ops is law: arch → types → lint/CI → tests → docs. Docs-only lessons that agents re-violate fail the scorecard (docs_only_lessons=0).
A real gate exits non-zero, is deterministic, fails closed, and is a required status check. Logging that exits 0 is observation, not encode.
auto_merge=0 — never merge without Boyd OK; Draft Day / burn never enable auto-merge or gh pr merge.
Every new check must fail on a real past-mistake fixture; unproven_checks=0.
Do not collapse Pre-ops, Draft Day, and Correct CI into one LGTM. Peer Arena LGTM ≠ pre-ops Apply ≠ encode complete.
Agent-authored PRs stay draft unless human_ready; writer identity never LGTMs or merges its own PR.
Every gate report stamps LIVE vs SYNTHETIC; sandbox demo CI is never sold as BoydVC main protection.
America/New_York stamps on encode tickets and scorecards; utc_only_stamps=0.
Private BoydVC / personal-GitHub agent tooling only. No KPD. No burn outbound. No cloud agents from research burn. burn_merge_or_send=0.

separation: brief-007 = pre-ops touch-prod card; brief-012 = Draft Day arena→draft PR; brief-004 = Peer Arena critique; brief-024 = /correct CI encoding specialization (mistake class → structure → required merge-blocking check)
